text:
108E. (a) If the master of a nuclear ship fails to 344G(1), Imprisonment which may

give the notice required by sub-section (2) and (5) extend to one year or fine
(1) or sub-section (2) or sub-section which may extend to ten
(5) of section 344G; thousand rupees or both.

(b) if the master of a nuclear ship fails to 344G(3) Imprisonment which may

comply with any directions issued and (5) extend to one year or fine
under sub-section (3) or sub-section which may extend to ten
(5) of section 344G. thousand rupees or both.]
